children: Ocugen announced first patient dosed in the global Phase 3 registrational trial of OCU410 for geographic atrophy and DMC advised completing 8-month follow-up in the OCU410ST interim review.
First patient dosed in Phase 3 registrational trial of OCU410 (AAV5-hRORA) for GA after FDA Type B EOP2 alignment on Phase 3 design.
FDA granted OCU410 RMAT designation; Phase 3 design agreed on endpoints, dose, adaptive design and single pivotal trial pathway for BLA.
DMC completed interim analysis of OCU410ST (26 subjects) and recommended continuing per protocol to obtain 8-month follow-up for full dataset.
DMC noted interim sample showed negative treatment direction and baseline lesion imbalance, so full 8-month data needed for assessment.
Presentation reiterates Phase 1/2 and Phase 2 topline results: OCU410 showed ~31% lesion reduction and favorable safety supporting Phase 3 initiation.

title: Ocugen doses first patient in Phase 3 OCU410 trial; DMC recommends continuing OCU410ST with 8-month follow-up
